steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-18, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 15.7 | 1.56 | 1.56
2 | 188.9 | 15.69 | 17.25
3 | 183.8 | 0.79 | 18.04
4 | 106.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-18, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-18 (Survey Area T)**

**Layer Model:**
- **Layer 1 (0.00–1.56 m):** 15.7 Ω·m (topsoil/clayey overburden)
- **Layer 2 (1.56–17.25 m):** 188.9 Ω·m (resistive stratum)
- **Layer 3 (17.25–18.04 m):** 183.8 Ω·m (intermediate transition)
- **Layer 4 (>18.04 m):** 106.9 Ω·m (lower target zone)

**Curve-Type Evaluation:**
Evaluating consecutive three-layer groups:
- Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ (15.7 < 188.9 > 183.8 Ω·m) $\rightarrow$ **K**
- Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4$ (188.9 > 183.8 > 106.9 Ω·m) $\rightarrow$ **Q**

The calculated sounding curve type is **KQ**. 

**Discrepancy Note:**
The on-file classification lists this station as an **A-type** curve ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$), which does not fit the interpreted layer resistivity values.
